articles.headline: Live transfer rumors, news, updates on deadline day
articles.description: We bring you the latest news, rumors, done deals and reaction throughout Europe's transfer deadline day, up to the Premier League window closing at 6 p.m. ET.

articles.headline: Man City agree record-equalling £125m deal with Chelsea for Enzo Fernández - sources
articles.description: Manchester City have agreed a Premier League record-equalling £125 million ($169m) deal with Chelsea for Enzo Fernández, sources have told ESPN.

articles.headline: Summer transfer window: Grading big signings in men's soccer
articles.description: The 2026 summer transfer window is open. Here is how we rated the biggest deals.

articles.headline: Chelsea's €45m Lamine Camara bid rejected amid Enzo Fernández talks - sources
articles.description: Chelsea have made a €45 million bid for Monaco midfielder Lamine Camara amid ongoing talks with Manchester City over the possible departure of Enzo Fernández, sources have told ESPN.

articles.headline: Gabriel Jesus completes transfer to Barcelona from Arsenal
articles.description: Barcelona have completed the signing of Gabriel Jesus from Arsenal, the two clubs confirmed on Tuesday.

articles.headline: Gabriel Jesus took pay cut for 'dream' Barcelona transfer from Arsenal
articles.description: Gabriel Jesus said he took a pay cut to ensure he landed his "dream" transfer after signing for Barcelona from Arsenal on Tuesday.

articles.headline: Ogden: Man Utd failing to sign a defender is a 'dereliction of duty'
articles.description: Ogden: Man Utd failing to sign a defender is a 'dereliction of duty'

articles.headline: Kone? Camara? Chelsea working hard to bring in Fernandez replacement
articles.description: Chelsea are working hard to line up a replacement for Enzo Fernandez before the transfer deadline.

articles.headline: Honest Ahanor joins Crystal Palace on loan, will join Chelsea in 2027
articles.description: Chelsea have agreed a deal to sign Atalanta defender Honest Ahanor, with the player set to move to Stamford Bridge in 2027.

articles.headline: Crystal Palace swoop for Malick Fofana despite Sunderland talks - sources
articles.description: Crystal Palace have made a late move to hijack Sunderland's move for Lyon star Malick Fofana and are optimistic of securing his signature, sources have told ESPN.

articles.headline: Ibrahim Mbaye and Taylor Harwood-Bellis join Aston Villa
articles.description: Aston Villa confirmed the signings of Ibrahim Mbaye and Taylor Harwood-Bellis on Transfer Deadline Day.

articles.headline: Fabio Vieira joins Hamburg in permanent deal from Arsenal
articles.description: Fabio Vieira has completed a permanent move to Bundesliga side Hamburg SV from Arsenal.

articles.headline: Fulham near deal for Real Madrid's Manuel Ángel, Frankfurt's Hugo Larsson - sources
articles.description: Fulham are closing in on the signings of Manuel Ángel from Real Madrid and Hugo Larsson from Eintracht Frankfurt but the move for Andrei Ratiu from Rayo Vallecano is in doubt, sources have told ESPN.

articles.headline: Every Deadline Day deal....
articles.description: The 2026 summer transfer window closes in England at 11pm on September 1. Keep track of all the done deals across the key leagues on Deadline Day.

articles.headline: Tottenham agree deal for Chelsea duo Mykhailo Mudryk, Tosin Adarabioyo - sources
articles.description: Tottenham have agreed a double deal to sign Mykhailo Mudryk and Tosin Adarabioyo from Chelsea, sources have told ESPN.

articles.headline: Arsenal's Ethan Nwaneri close to Borussia Dortmund loan - sources
articles.description: Arsenal midfielder Ethan Nwaneri is heading to Borussia Dortmund on loan, sources have told ESPN.

articles.headline: Arsenal's Mikel Arteta downplays Cristhian Mosquera injury concerns
articles.description: Arsenal boss Mikel Arteta says Cristhian Mosquera is "fine" and was taken off as a precaution during Monday night's 1-0 win at Aston Villa after the Spanish defender reported feeling pain.

articles.headline: Africa's transfer deadline day - Ndiaye to Man City, Mbaye incoming, Osimhen to Man United?
articles.description: Tuesday is the final day of the window, but which African players could get their move over the line before business concludes on Sept. 1?

articles.headline: Yoane Wissa's Newcastle sequel is already looking better than the original
articles.description: Two matches into the 26-27 season, and Newcastle United's Yoane Wissa has already matched his Premier League goal tally for the entirety of last term.

articles.headline: Arsenal win at Villa shows they're OK without transfer move, but an attacker would help
articles.description: As good as Arsenal already are, it's clear an attacking transfer boost could take the club to a new level in the Premier League title race.

articles.headline: Transfer rumors, news: Spurs to make late move for Pulisic?
articles.description: The deadline for the summer window in Europe closes tomorrow, and Tottenham Hotspur are interested in AC Milan winger Christian Pulisic. Transfer Talk has the latest.

articles.description: Richarlison has opened the door for an emotional return to Everton but warned "never again will anyone decide my future for me" in a thinly-veiled dig on social media.
